d:
In today’s episode, we sit down with Dr. David Sinclair, A.O., Ph.D., Longevity Scientist and Professor of Genetics, Harvard Medical School, to understand the science of aging and whether we can actually slow it down.
We discuss why our bodies age, what happens to our cells as we get older, and how genetics, lifestyle, and cellular health influence longevity.
The conversation also explores what we can do today to stay healthier for longer and where the science of longevity is heading.
